# Notice for the kernel template files

- `kernel/kernel.tpl` is a kernel image built from Apple's open-source XNU (xnu-8796, the macOS 13.5 / iOS 16 generation,
  fetched by blacktop/darwin-xnu-build at the commit pinned in `.github/workflows/xnu.yml`) plus this port's patches
  (`xnu/patches/`, source of the recompiled files in `xnu/stage-q10jfinal44ts/`). It was produced from the q10jfinal19
  line by `components/release-20261115/tools/make_release.sh`; the per-device values were replaced by fixed placeholders
  (`n2_kernel_pins.py check` reports `PINS_LEFT` for all seven pins of `pins-map.json`, i.e. the template is intact and
  must never be flashed as is). Apple's XNU is published under the Apple Public Source License 2.0; the CI build may also
  link Apple-provided kernel support libraries of the build SDK. **Check the upstream licences before redistributing;
  they were not verified for this file.** Strings show only CI-runner build paths (`/Users/runner/...`).
- `kernel/template.adt` is an Apple Device Tree generated by the port's tools; it contains the iPhone X (D22AP)
  `/product` node data copied from Apple's device tree (Apple-originated data). **Check upstream licence.**
- `host-tools/loader-Image`, `host-tools/stub-Image` are the port's boot shim/loader binaries (source in `shim/`).
- `payloads/bt/n2btd` is the port's Bluetooth daemon (source in `components/bt-20261115/n2btd/`).
- Not included from the release builder output: `payloads/jbts/inputs/debs/*` and `payloads/jbts/inputs/trollstore/*`
  (third-party binaries; download and verify them with `build_jbts.py`, names in `README-INPUTS.md`) and `vm/initramfs/`
  (GPL userland binaries copied from the build host; rebuild with `resume/research-nord2/rootfs-vm/prepare.py`).
  `MANIFEST.sha256` still lists them, so a manifest check reports them as missing.
